key_reasoning.reason: BudgetService gains _build_budget_reassignment_marker and three callers (assign_budget_to_user, bulk_set_user_budgets, reset_user_budget_spending) that cross into project_spend_tracking_repository — 2-3 components across Service and DB-Persistence layers.

The carry-over logic is new: reads the outgoing budget's latest spend row, compares spend_date against the incoming budget's row, and constructs a ProjectSpendTracking marker. The timestamp comparison edge case (return vs. fresher row) has no direct predecessor in the file, but the overall pattern builds on the established spend-tracking repository interface.
